deploy-bot: deploy finished: release 2026.03.21-72 -> prod-eu1. kicking off post-deploy smoke (synth id=sr-20260321-72, probes=short-scan + burst-scan).

sre-oncall: seeing a small spike in embed 429s coincident with synth start, currently ~1.8% but user traffic steady.

sam: quick check — is synth tagged? headers show x-synth=true. also burst-scan concurrency=40.

lee: new embed variant has lower soft quota for cold-starts. burst=40 might be too high. recommend immediate throttle to 8rps and reduce burst to 15.

sre-oncall: executing: `/synthctl update sr-20260321-72 --target-rps 8`

deploy-bot: synth updated: target=8rps. note: burst-concurrency unchanged.

observability-bot: auto-suppress alert for sr-20260321-72 due to throttle. monitoring embed.5xx and embed.p95.

sam: manual check against production user path: 200 OK, p95 130ms, no increase in 5xx.

lee: follow-up: I'll open a quick change to make default burst cap for new model variants = 20 and add annotation to synth-run template.

sre-oncall: we'll keep thread open for 20m. rollback not planned unless user error rate rises above 0.5%.
